_doc: Intentional differences between schema.prisma and the Cloudflare SQLite schema (task 1.6). Anything else must match exactly, so a Prisma change that is not mirrored fails parity.test.ts.

representations.Decimal: INTEGER scaled by 10^scale (generated/manifest.json decimals); percent columns are hundredths, fx rates are 1e-8 units
representations.String[]: TEXT JSON array with CHECK json_valid AND json_type = 'array'
representations.BigInt: INTEGER (SQLite 64-bit; the app reads it as a JS number, safe below 2^53, which the byte and micro counters never reach)

renamedColumns.reason: the DO store row is keyed by the store id it lives in

unsupportedNotCarried.reason: halfvec(1024) has no SQLite type; the model targets analytics/R2 (Vectorize), not the StoreDO
